parameters.content:
## v4.0.1 - Real ticket creation
1. Select your Google Sheets credential, Document and Sheet from lists.
2. **LAST: Data Mode -> Auto-Map Input Data to Columns.** Headers: time, sender, category, draft_reply.
3. **Save AND Publish** this helper.
4. For a standalone Sheet check, click Execute workflow: **TEST HELPER - fictional sample** supplies labelled test inputs and writes one SETUP TEST row.
5. For real workshop requests, use **03 Agent -> Open chat**. In create_ticket choose this helper, then enable all FOUR sparkle buttons.

Empty real calls return SETUP HELP and write nothing. No customer text is invented to fill missing inputs. No email, Slack post or refund is sent.
